title: Employee Benefits
summary: Prescribes the accounting and disclosure for employee benefits, including the projected unit credit method and OCI remeasurements, converged with IAS 19, with a genuine Indian plan-classification nuance for EPFO-administered funds.

bannerNotice.title: Ind AS — Converged with IAS 19, with a Genuine Plan-Classification Nuance
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 19's defined benefit measurement model (projected unit credit method, OCI remeasurements) mirrors IAS 19 closely. The distinctive Indian consideration is that EPFO-administered Provident Fund contributions, which carry a GOVERNMENT INTEREST RATE GUARANTEE, may require DEFINED BENEFIT treatment rather than the simpler defined contribution treatment — a genuinely important classification nuance for Indian employers. Section 11 covers the full comparison.
